prayer.title: Petition for the suffering and captives — from Commemoration (1982)
prayer.locator: Commemoration of the Living and the Dead, printed pp.29–30

blocks.text: Save, Lord, and have mercy on the old and the young, the poor, the orphans and widows, and on those who are in sickness and in sadness, in misfortunes and in sorrow, in war and in captivity, in prison and in exile—especially those who, being Thy servants, are persecuted for Thy sake and the Orthodox Faith by godless heathens, apostates, and heretics. Remember, visit, strengthen, and comfort them, giving them early release, freedom, and deliverance by Thy might.
blocks.locator: Commemoration of the Living and the Dead, printed p.29–30

sources.rightsNote: The official Project Gutenberg catalogue and preserved metadata designate this edition public domain in the USA. This does not assert public-domain status worldwide. The introduction identifies its Psalms as RSV-based; those Psalm passages are excluded here. Morning Prayers and Compline are not presented as complete native rules because their Psalm passages were not reproduced. The full 1982 wording and sequence of included prayer units is retained, including historical OCA jurisdictional titles, source rubrics, and liturgical alternatives. This is not the 2019 St. Tikhon’s edition or the user’s Mother of God Church rule.
